_comment: Proposed internal defaults from plan sections 7. To be agreed with McKesson security team; not McKesson policy.
_semgrep_note: Heuristic rules that cannot tell parameterised from concatenated SQL are capped so they flag for review without blocking on their own.

required_tools._note: A project cannot turn these off in config.env. To waive one, add a time-boxed entry {tool, reason, approved_by, expires} to .security/exceptions.json.

presets._note: Defaults a team gets by choosing SEC_PRESET. Any explicit SEC_* setting overrides the preset. Tool values: auto (run when it fits) | on | off.
